text:
TCP::idletime
Description
This iRule command sets the TCP idle timeout. Sets the number of seconds before BIG-IP deletes connections with no traffic. A value of zero indicates no time limit.
Syntax
TCP
::
idletime
<
timeval
>
Examples
when
SERVER_CONNECTED
{
log
local0.
"Client: [client_addr]:[client_port] - Server: [server_addr]:[server_port]."
# Set server-side idletime to 100.
TCP
::
idletime
100
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
All events
